The small print

Policies

Last updated 24 November 2026.

Privacy Policy

Who we are

God’s Plan Apparel, Harare, Zimbabwe. Contact us on WhatsApp at 078 447 3728 or Instagram @godsplan_appareal.

What we collect

Only what we need to take and deliver your order: your name (optional), your delivery area, what you order, and your phone number, which we see when you message us on WhatsApp. This website has no accounts or sign-ups and never asks for card details.

How we get it

When you tap “Send order on WhatsApp”, your choices are put into a WhatsApp message that you send to us yourself. Nothing reaches us until you press send in WhatsApp.

Why we use it

To confirm your order, arrange a meet-up delivery and receive your EcoCash payment. We do not sell your information or use it for advertising.

How long we keep it

We keep order messages only as long as we need them to complete your order and for our basic records.

Other companies

WhatsApp and Instagram (Meta) handle the messages and links you open. EcoCash handles your payment. This site loads fonts from Google Fonts and a small QR-code script from jsDelivr, which can see your IP address when the page loads. This site does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies of its own.

Your choices

Message us any time to see, correct or delete your details. We aim to handle personal data responsibly and in line with the laws that apply in Zimbabwe.

Terms & Conditions

Orders

An order is confirmed when we confirm it to you on WhatsApp. Limited Edition tees and discount spots are limited and handled first come, first served.

Prices

Prices are in US dollars: The Names $10, Limited Edition $12, Full Set of 5 Names $40. Delivery around Harare is by meet-up. An extra fee applies beyond Harare, and we tell you the amount before you pay.

Discounts

A discount is available to 10 people who order through this website. We confirm who qualifies and the discounted price with you on WhatsApp.

Payment

Pay by EcoCash to 078 447 3728 after we confirm your order.

Products

Pictures are digital mockups and colours can look slightly different. Please choose your size carefully, and ask us if you are unsure.

Our designs

The designs and content on this site belong to God’s Plan Apparel unless stated otherwise. Please do not copy them without permission.

Your rights and the law

Nothing here limits your rights under Zimbabwean consumer law. These terms are governed by the laws of Zimbabwe.

Cookies Policy

What we use

We use only your browser’s local storage on this device: first, to remember your cookie choice; second, if you accept, to keep your cart so it is still there when you come back. We do not use advertising, analytics or tracking cookies.

Other companies

Google Fonts and jsDelivr load when you open the page. WhatsApp and Instagram are only involved when you tap their links.

Your choice

You can decline, and the site still works, but your cart will not be remembered. Change your cookie choice or clear this site’s data in your browser settings.

Refund Policy

Wrong or faulty item

Tell us on WhatsApp within 3 days of receiving your tee, with a photo. We will exchange it or refund you by EcoCash.

Wrong size

Ask for an exchange within 3 days if the tee is unworn and unwashed. This depends on stock, and Limited Edition tees may sell out.

Changed your mind

Because our tees are limited, we do not offer refunds for a change of mind unless we agree it together on WhatsApp.

Not received

If your agreed delivery does not happen, tell us and we will sort it out or refund you.
